entries.title: Psalms 24:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> The earth [is] the LORD'S, and all its fullness, The world and those who dwell therein.

entries.title: Psalms 24:2
segments: For He has founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the waters.

entries.title: Psalms 24:3
segments: ¶Who may ascend into the hill of the LORD? Or who may stand in His holy place?

entries.title: Psalms 24:4
segments: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, Who has not lifted up his soul to an idol, Nor sworn deceitfully.

entries.title: Psalms 24:5
segments: He shall receive blessing from the LORD, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 24:6
segments: This [is] Jacob, the generation of those who seek Him, Who seek Your face. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 24:7
segments: ¶Lift up your heads, O you gates! And be lifted up, you everlasting doors! And the King of glory shall come in.

entries.title: Psalms 24:8
segments: Who [is] this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, The LORD mighty in battle.

entries.title: Psalms 24:9
segments: Lift up your heads, O you gates! Lift up, you everlasting doors! And the King of glory shall come in.

entries.title: Psalms 24:10
segments: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, He [is] the King of glory. Selah
